page_title: GET 0-2 RAY | Getafe v Rayo Vallecano 03/05/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 91' The substitution has been made. Oscar Valentin (Rayo Vallecano) has replaced Gerard Gumbau.
90+6' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+5' It doesn’t look good for Martin Satriano (Getafe); looks like he’ll have to leave the pitch!
90+3' The game is interrupted. Javier Munoz (Getafe) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
90+1' Miguel Sesma shows a yellow card to Randy Nteka (Rayo Vallecano) for a tough tackle.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
89' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano).
88' The number of shots on goal at present is 2:6.
88' 11:10 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
86' Randy Nteka (Rayo Vallecano) came close to scoring but should have done much better. His poor attempt from close range ended up in the gloves of David Soria.
85' Mauro Arambarri (Getafe) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Augusto Batalla intercepts the ball.
85' A yellow card for a tackle by Nobel Mendy (Rayo Vallecano). Miguel Sesma doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
82' Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) commits a rough challenge and Miguel Sesma blows his whistle for a foul.

80' What an opportunity! Martin Satriano (Getafe) squanders a huge opportunity as he latches on to a perfect cross from the wing. He produces a bullet header from around the penalty spot which goes just wide of the left post! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Rayo Vallecano.
79' Jose Bordalas Jimenez prepares a substitution. Luis Vazquez is replaced by Borja Mayoral (Getafe).
79' Substitution. Luis Milla walks off the pitch and Javier Munoz (Getafe) comes on as a substitute.
78' The possession of the ball – 54:46.
76' Martin Satriano (Getafe) brings an opponent down and Miguel Sesma interrupts the game.

73' 0 - 2 Randy Nteka (Rayo Vallecano) doesn't hesitate to lash home from just outside the box. He hit the ball precisely and it bounced in off the crossbar behind the helpless goalkeeper. What a hit!
73' Gerard Gumbau (Rayo Vallecano) fails to produce a decent cross from the corner kick. The ball goes well out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Getafe.

72' Pep Chavarria (Rayo Vallecano) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending. The ball goes out for a corner. Rayo Vallecano can continue in their attacking effort.
70' The referee signals a substitution. Randy Nteka (Rayo Vallecano) is brought on as a substitute for Sergio Camello.
69' Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Miguel Sesma stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
68' Substitution. Andrei Ratiu (Rayo Vallecano) on for Alemao.
68' Inigo Perez has decided to substitute Jorge de Frutos and he is replaced by Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano).
68' Substitution. Pacha did his best and is replaced by Pep Chavarria (Rayo Vallecano).
67' The attendance for today's match is 7693.
65' The rebound finds Luis Vazquez (Getafe) in space inside the box, but his shot flies high over the bar. That was a promising chance!
64' Mauro Arambarri (Getafe) has a great chance to score from the penalty. He shoots to the bottom left corner, but Augusto Batalla leaps out to thwart his attempt.
63' Mauro Arambarri (Getafe) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
61' Miguel Sesma shows a yellow card to Augusto Batalla (Rayo Vallecano) for his blatant foul.
61' Augusto Batalla (Rayo Vallecano) commits a rough foul. Miguel Sesma stops the game and makes a call. Joy for one side, despair for the other as the referee gives a penalty to Getafe!
61' One of the Getafe players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
59' Miguel Sesma couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Sergio Camello (Rayo Vallecano) and blew his whistle.
57' Augusto Batalla (Rayo Vallecano) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
55' Abdel Abqar (Getafe) sees a yellow card from Miguel Sesma after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.

53' That didn't go as planned! Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort towards the bottom right corner was too weak to get past David Soria, who easily kept it out.
52' David Soria displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Pacha (Rayo Vallecano) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
51' Getafe failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
51' Getafe play a few nice passes from player to player, but their possession doesn't last long as an opposition player intercepts a pass. Getafe will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
50' Pathe Ciss (Rayo Vallecano) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Miguel Sesma didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.

49' That was close by Alemao (Rayo Vallecano)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes inches wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Getafe will have a goal kick.
47' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Getafe.
47' Getafe are passing the ball across the pitch and keep possession. However, an opponent intercepts a pass and the situation changes. Good work from Getafe as they win a corner.
46' Luis Vazquez (Getafe) sees a yellow! His tackle wasn't that harsh, but he probably talked himself into Miguel Sesma's book.
46' Half-time substitution. Jose Bordalas Jimenez decided to make a change. Kiko Femenia (Getafe) is replaced by Alex Sancris.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Adrian Liso (Getafe) comes off for Diego Rico.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Davinchi (Getafe) is replaced by Abu Kamara.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+6' The end of the first half.
45+5' Sergio Camello (Rayo Vallecano) had an opportunity from long range. His low shot was directed towards the middle of the goal, but David Soria was alert and made a comfortable save.

45+5' Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) had a good chance to change the score. He ran towards the goal and unleashed a shot from just outside the penalty area which went towards the left side of the goal, but the goalkeeper was ready and made an amazing save.
45+5' The Rayo Vallecano players’ celebrations are quickly cut short after referee Miguel Sesma signals NO GOAL following the VAR review due to a handball.
45+4' Possible change! There could be handball by the attacking team in the lead up. Referee Miguel Sesma wants to look at it, so he’s going to review using VAR.
45+3' The ball is in the net but it’s immediately ruled out by referee Miguel Sesma due to a handball, much to the disappointment of the Martin Satriano (Getafe) and his team.
45+1' Adrian Liso (Getafe) serves up a nice cross, but Augusto Batalla punches the ball away.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
44' Whoa! Such gestures are commonly penalised and Domingos Duarte (Getafe) duly receives a yellow card.
43' Martin Satriano (Getafe) places a shot at goal from the edge of the box that bends just wide of the right post.
41' Mauro Arambarri (Getafe) tackles a bit over-zealously and Miguel Sesma blows for a foul.
39' Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez (Getafe) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
38' 0 - 1 GOAL! Sergio Camello (Rayo Vallecano) gets to the ball on the edge of the box after a huge mistake by an opponent and slams it into the back of the net. He makes it 0:1.
37' A cross from Martin Satriano (Getafe) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
36' Sergio Camello (Rayo Vallecano) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Miguel Sesma has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
34' A corner kick by Getafe is thwarted by the well prepared Augusto Batalla (Rayo Vallecano).
34' Getafe are enjoying a spell of pressure at the moment, but one of the defenders gets it clear. Getafe have been awarded a corner kick.
34' Luis Milla (Getafe) is adjudged offside.
32' Getafe can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
32' Getafe are just stroking the ball across the park now, but the defence is doing very well breaking up their possession. Getafe win a corner.
30' The current number of fouls conceded by both teams is 4:6.
29' Alemao (Rayo Vallecano) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
27' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Rayo Vallecano was in an offside position.
26' Alemao (Rayo Vallecano) goes for goal but he blazes his shot well over the top.
24' Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
23' Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
22' The current number of shots on goal is 0:0.
22' Davinchi (Getafe) is penalised for a foul. Miguel Sesma had a clear view and blows his whistle.
20' PENALTY APPEAL by Rayo Vallecano, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!
19' Sergio Camello (Rayo Vallecano) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
17' Mauro Arambarri (Getafe) sends a cross into the box, but Augusto Batalla comes off his line to gather the ball.
17' Miguel Sesma blows his whistle after Gerard Gumbau (Rayo Vallecano) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
15' Davinchi (Getafe) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Augusto Batalla, who smothers the ball.
13' Kiko Femenia (Getafe) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
12' The referee blows his whistle as Mauro Arambarri (Getafe) was too aggressive in his challenge.
11' Sergio Camello (Rayo Vallecano) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball.
9' Rough tackle by Gerard Gumbau (Rayo Vallecano). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
8' Mauro Arambarri (Getafe) was too forceful with his tackle and Miguel Sesma interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
6' Gerard Gumbau (Rayo Vallecano) picks up the rebound on the edge of the box and shoots. His effort, however, only finds the gloves of the opponent's goalkeeper.
6' Pacha (Rayo Vallecano) sends a teasing cross into the area, but David Soria intercepts the ball.
5' Rayo Vallecano enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
5' Sergio Camello (Rayo Vallecano) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
2' The Getafe players are exchanging some short passes.
1' The first half has just begun.
Rayo Vallecano will kick the game off.
